description: This file defines the DBManagerFactory class responsible for creating and managing database driver instances, including selection based on database type and configuration, loading appropriate driver classes, and managing multiple database connections.

classes.name: DBManagerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing database driver instances based on configuration and database type.

methods.name: getTypeInstance
methods.description: Returns a database driver object for a specific database type and configuration.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of a database manager for a given connection instance name.

methods.name: disconnectAll
methods.description: Disconnects all active database connections managed by the factory.

methods.name: getManagerByType
methods.description: Returns the class name of a database driver matching a specified type.

methods.name: scanDriverDir
methods.description: Scans a directory for valid database driver classes and populates the drivers array.

methods.name: _compareDrivers
methods.description: Compares two driver objects based on their priority for sorting purposes.

methods.name: getDbDrivers
methods.description: Returns a list of all available database driver objects, optionally validating their availability.

methods.name: isFreeTDS
methods.description: Checks if the FreeTDS driver is installed on the system, used when connecting to MS SQL Server.
